description: Read an owned Modeler operation's stage, recent progress, model resource, session link, and Credit settlement. Poll about every 10 seconds. A succeeded operation's GLB can be retrieved through get_asset_artifact_manifest even while modeler.billingState is pending. Continue checking until billingState is settled to verify finalized Credits and released reservations. Does not start work or spend Credits; download URLs remain behind the artifact tools and their mint:generate:approve scope.
name: get_modeler_operation
title: Get Modeler progress
